excerpt: The Adaptive Agentic Intelligence Framework (AAIF), built with Strands Agents, handles routine tasks locally with small language models and routes complex requests to cloud models through Amazon Bedrock. This post walks through building AAIF with local SLMs through Ollama and Amazon Bedrock, using an Internet of Things monitoring scenario.
